notes.subject: עמי נדיב
notes.rationale: Famously obscure: 'chariots of my princely people' (ASV/JPS) vs 'chariots of Amminadib' as a proper name (KJV) vs 'my people-Nadib' (YLT); name reading kept here.

notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש is throat/breath/life-force, rendered bel per discipline D4.

notes.subject: whole verse
notes.rationale: Deliberately opaque — the speaker does not know what came over him; most opaque verse of the song.

translation: Mi no save; bel bilong mi i putim mi olsem long ol karet bilong ol man bilong mi, bilong bikman Nadib.
